title: Lightsabers (easy)
statementMd:
There is unrest in the Galactic Senate. Several thousand solar systems have declared their intentions to leave the Republic. Master Heidi needs to select the Jedi Knights who will go on peacekeeping missions throughout the galaxy. It is well-known that the success of any peacekeeping mission depends on the colors of the lightsabers of the Jedi who will go on that mission.

Heidi has $*n*$ Jedi Knights standing in front of her, each one with a lightsaber of one of $*m*$ possible colors. She knows that for the mission to be the most effective, she needs to select some contiguous interval of knights such that there are exactly $*k*_{1}$ knights with lightsabers of the first color, $*k*_{2}$ knights with lightsabers of the second color, $...$, $*k*_{*m*}$ knights with lightsabers of the $*m*$-th color. Help her find out if this is possible.

## Input

The first line of the input contains $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ *n*$). The second line contains $*n*$ integers in the range ${1, 2, ..., *m*}$ representing colors of the lightsabers of the subsequent Jedi Knights. The third line contains $*m*$ integers $*k*_{1}, *k*_{2}, ..., *k*_{*m*}$ (with ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/028ad21fa922d9cfdf096d658a7e651e74feddcf.png)) – the desired counts of lightsabers of each color from $1$ to $*m*$.

## Output

Output `YES` if an interval with prescribed color counts exists, or output `NO` if there is none.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
银河议会中局势动荡。数千个太阳系已经宣布打算脱离共和国。海蒂大师需要选出将前往银河系各地执行维和任务的绝地武士。众所周知，任何维和任务能否成功，取决于执行任务的绝地武士所持光剑的颜色。

海蒂面前站着 $*n*$ 名绝地武士，每个人都持有 $*m*$ 种可能颜色中的一种光剑。她知道，为了使任务最有效，她需要选取一段连续的武士，使其中恰好有 $*k*_{1}$ 名武士持有第一种颜色的光剑，$*k*_{2}$ 名武士持有第二种颜色的光剑，$...$，以及 $*k*_{*m*}$ 名武士持有第 $*m*$ 种颜色的光剑。请帮助她判断这是否可能。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$）和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ *n*$）。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数，范围为 ${1, 2, ..., *m*}$，表示从前往后排列的绝地武士所持光剑的颜色。第三行包含 $*m*$ 个整数 $*k*_{1}, *k*_{2}, ..., *k*_{*m*}$（其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/028ad21fa922d9cfdf096d658a7e651e74feddcf.png)），表示从第 $1$ 种到第 $*m*$ 种颜色的光剑所需的数量。

## 输出格式

如果存在满足指定颜色数量的连续区间，输出 `YES`；否则输出 `NO`。
</statement>
